tasks.short: Analyse news sources and interpret information for broadcast

steps.what: Analyze and interpret news from different sources for broadcast
Broadcast the interpreted information and preserve relevant qualifications

tasks.design: Keep news interpretation with the journalist using source material in {DOCS}. The journalist delivers the checked interpretation through the broadcast production system in {OTHER}, preserving uncertainty and attribution.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different source accounts need contextual evaluation before they can be responsibly interpreted.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional component is proposed for interpretation or live delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling conflicting accounts and explaining what remains unknown under broadcast deadlines.
tasks.human_edge: The journalist judges significance and adjusts the account when new information changes its meaning.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in interpretation responsibility or broadcast authority.

reach.task: Prepare a clearly qualified segment interpretation
reach.learn: Programme timing and editorial clearance practice

evidence.claim: Multi-source news interpretation and live delivery require contextual judgement; no labour reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is interpretation and broadcast delivery, excluding primary newsgathering and separate script production. Related story preparation is counted once in a roll-up.

OTHER means the existing broadcast production system. Sources provide reports before s1; the journalist evaluates them in s1. The editor provides existing clearance after interpretation and before s2; its existing labour is unchanged outside the focal boundary.
The journalist checks the intended account immediately before delivery in s2. Material changes require a renewed human check; no automatic broadcast or new structured input feed is proposed.
Use native production facilities; zero incremental upkeep because no new component or recurring work is introduced.
research_questions: Which source conflicts consume interpretation time that cannot be resolved by faster text production?

already_counted.description: Contextual interpretation and deliberate broadcast delivery

approvals.approved_version: Exact intended news account, source qualifications, programme and editorial clearance reference checked immediately before delivery; material updates void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. Interpretation and broadcast delivery remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct taped or filmed interviews or narratives

tasks.design: Retain the recorded interview or narrative with the journalist using the recording equipment in {OTHER}. The journalist listens, follows up and adapts delivery to the participant and evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: A useful recorded account requires responsive questioning and credible delivery.
tasks.enabler_now: Recording is already supported; no new component replaces the interview itself.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing out accurate information and recognising when a response needs challenge or clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The journalist notices hesitation, contradiction and new information and changes the next question.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in interview ownership or performance responsibility.

reach.task: Coordinate interview continuity and recording handoffs
reach.learn: Framing, sound and production continuity requirements

evidence.claim: Amberscript offers machine and human-checked transcripts, but transcription is downstream of conducting the recorded interview and supplies no saving for this task boundary.

assumptions: Boundary is conducting the recorded interaction or narrative, excluding interview arrangement, transcription and editing.

Participants provide responses during s1 after the interview starts; the journalist produces the recording through the existing equipment. No structured response feed, new participant form or synthetic interview is assumed.
OTHER means existing audio or video recording equipment. Native recording runtime is not human labour and earns no new saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new component or recurring process is proposed.
research_questions: Which production handoff problems interfere with responsive questioning during recorded interviews?

already_counted.description: Responsive recorded interview or narrative delivery

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; downstream transcription is not treated as interview time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Revise reporting for editorial and length requirements

steps.what: Interpret editorial comments and identify required revisions
Revise work to fit the editorial brief and required length

loop.purpose: Propose tracked cuts and wording changes within the selected revision brief
loop.input: story version, checked revision instructions, protected quotations and target length
loop.check: Compare revised meaning, attribution, caveats and chronology with the original and editorial brief; verify that cuts do not imply unsupported conclusions
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; journalist rewrites manually if meaning or protected text changes
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native spelling and style checks first; meaningful compression requires context beyond word counting

steps.what: Verify revisions and return the exact final version for editorial approval

tasks.design: Use native spelling and style checks in {DOCS} first, then a bounded step to propose tracked revisions against the journalist's checked brief. The journalist verifies meaning and length before returning the exact version through {CMS} for the existing editor approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shortening and editorial changes can accidentally remove attribution or alter the story's implication.
tasks.enabler_now: Tracked rewrite suggestions can reduce initial wording effort while preserving a comparison with the source version.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which detail is essential and whether an edit creates a misleading impression.
tasks.human_edge: The journalist understands the reporting and can challenge a cut that would distort it.
tasks.altitude: Less initial rewriting; editorial judgement and final responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Adapt a checked account to a programme's length constraints

evidence.claim: LanguageTool checks spelling, grammar, punctuation and style and offers rephrasing; these native checks should precede custom revision assistance.
Meaning-preserving compression using checked instructions is plausible, but this task-specific time estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is post-draft revision through editor resubmission, excluding original story drafting and publication. Initial drafting and revision savings must apply to distinct work.

The editor supplies comments and target length through existing review. The journalist produces and captures the checked revision brief in s1: source version, required changes, protected quotations, facts and caveats, target word count or duration and destination. All interpretation and capture time remains counted; unclear instructions require human clarification.

Length measurement uses native counts; duration estimates require an actual delivery check when relevant, counted in s3. The bounded step proposes wording only and does not approve editorial compliance.
The editor's existing approval work stays outside the focal boundary; extra assisted-draft review is separately costed. Try native tracked changes and style tools before custom code.
unknowns: Whether model edits increase editor corrections
research_questions: Does tracked revision reduce total rewriting time without changing meaning or increasing editor review?

already_counted.description: Revision interpretation and final meaning and length checks
Inspect and correct proposed wording changes

incremental.description: Maintain revision examples and inspect meaning-change failures
Additional editor checks of assisted revisions

approvals.approved_version: Exact revised story version, tracked changes, target length and editor destination; edits void approval; publication remains with the editor

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R84.25 gives gross15.75 and net9.75 after6 focal upkeep;3 extra editor hours remain visible. Range1-5% assumes repeated straightforward cuts and allows detailed meaning review and manual rewriting.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop commentary ideas from news and experience

steps.what: Analyze news, current issues and personal experiences for commentary
Develop ideas and material for columns or commentaries

tasks.design: Keep commentary interpretation and idea development with the journalist using existing material in {DOCS}. The author chooses the perspective and distinguishes personal experience, opinion and factual support.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value lies in an accountable perspective grounded in actual experience and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional component is proposed for the author's viewpoint.
tasks.still_hard: Finding an original, defensible argument and recognising unsupported generalisations.
tasks.human_edge: The journalist contributes lived experience, voice and responsibility for the argument.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in creative or interpretive responsibility.

evidence.claim: Commentary idea development is contextual creative judgement; a high drafting prior does not establish that this interpretive work can be removed.

assumptions: Boundary is interpreting issues and developing commentary ideas or material, excluding separate background verification, final prose revision and publication.

The journalist supplies personal experiences and interprets existing reporting in s1, then develops the perspective in s2. No new structured opinion feed, fabricated experience or automated author viewpoint is assumed.
Use existing document and research facilities before a custom build; overlapping background research is counted once.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new system or recurring process is introduced.
research_questions: Where does idea development stall because evidence is missing rather than because prose is slow?

already_counted.description: Contextual interpretation and original commentary development

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; no creative interpretation or lived-experience contribution is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less initial wording revision; interviews, interpretation and commentary perspectives remain human.
reach: Prepare meaning-preserving story adaptations and commentary treatments for producers
role.ambitious_version: A journalist whose edits and interpretations remain faithful to the reporting and accountable to the audience.
